configurePresets.name: clang-mingw
configurePresets.displayName: clang++ targeting MinGW-w64 (no Windows SDK required)
configurePresets.description: This machine has no Windows SDK/UCRT, so clang must not use its default MSVC target. CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_TARGET makes CMake link against MinGW-w64 (C:\mingw64) instead.
